snippet: Fast single-stream inference for Naive-N0.5-Flash. NaiveRT combines fused CUDA kernels, speculative decoding, and GPU-driven execution across eight Blackwell GPUs. It is designed to shorten individual generations—particularly long agentic tasks and RL rollouts—with reproducible…
title: GitHub - NaiveAI-Labs/NaiveRT: NaiveRT: a self-contained TP8 inference runtime for the Naive N series on eight Blackwell GPUs with UMMA support. One persistent CUDA graph per rank runs draft, eight-row verify, top-p sampling and cache commit with no host in the loop: 1,700 tokens/s at batch size 1, one-second peaks above 2,000. · GitHub
